title: Prior Knowledge Makes It Possible: From Sublinear Graph Algorithms to LLM Test-Time Methods
authors: Avrim Blum; Daniel Hsu; Cyrus Rashtchian; Donya Saless
why_relevant: Provides a theoretical graph-based framework for the interplay between parametric knowledge and retrieval augmentation, including tolerance to noisy/false edges, which loosely connects to robustness of RAG.
